Tests type bincode decode, YAML output, and encode idempotence against fixtures.

# Purpose
This file defines a test program for `fd_types` and `fd_types_yaml` type handling. It loads a set of binary fixtures and expected YAML fixtures, then checks that each type can be decoded from bincode, walked into YAML, and compared against the stored YAML text. For fixtures marked for idempotence, it also checks that decoding and then re-encoding produces the same binary data.

The file builds a table of test fixtures with function pointers for each type-specific API, such as `fd_<type>_decode_footprint`, `fd_<type>_decode`, `fd_<type>_encode`, `fd_<type>_walk`, and, where present, the global decode and encode functions. The [`main`](<#main>) function sets up scratch memory, runs the YAML comparison test and the idempotence test for each fixture, and reports success only if all checks pass.
